title: incident-bot: runbook context enrichment + SLO toolkit on-call helpers
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: On-call responders frequently need quick access to curated runbook context and SLO-linked diagnostics during incidents. This PR enriches incident-bot messages with runbook metadata and SLO-toolkit helper commands to surface diagnostics and recommended remediation steps. It consolidates small on-call helper utilities used by SREs (runbook link resolver, autodiagnostics trigger, and quick SLO summaries) and wires them into the existing incident-bot command surface. Summary of changes: - Add runbook metadata resolver that fetches canonical runbook links and compact instructions (incident-bot/service/runbook_resolver). - Integrate SLO toolkit helpers to produce quick SLO summaries and suggested diagnostics for linked services (slo-toolkit/oncall_helpers). - New incident-bot commands: /runbook <incident-id|service>, /slo-summary <service>, /diag-runbook to run autodiagnostics tied to a runbook. - Add compact runbook view and link to Console runbook pages for faster navigation (redwood-console/oncall/helpers.ts). - Tests: unit + integration tests for command parsing and resolver cache; small e2e that exercises link rendering in Slack. Backwards compatibility: commands are additive and opt-in via incident-bot config. Rollout plan: feature gated by incident-bot flag incident_bot.runbook_enrichment=false by default. Gradual rollout: enable for SRE on-call rotation first, monitor metrics for command usage and latency. Observability: new metrics incident_bot.runbook_resolver.latency, incident_bot.runbook_cache.hit_rate, and slo_toolkit.oncall.summary_time introduced. Linked work: ENG-4021 (runbook UX), SRE-117 (autodiagnostics improvements).

merge_commit_message:
incident-bot: runbook context enrichment + SLO on-call helpers

Adds runbook resolver, SLO on-call helpers, commands (/runbook, /slo-summary, /diag-runbook), metrics, tests, and helm feature flag. Resolves ENG-4021, SRE-117.
release_notes:
- incident-bot: add /runbook and /slo-summary helpers for faster on-call context.
- SLO toolkit: on-call helper summaries and suggested diagnostics.
- Metrics: incident_bot.runbook_resolver.latency, incident_bot.runbook_cache.hit_rate.
- Feature gated behind incident_bot.runbook_enrichment (default: disabled).
testing_instructions: 1) Deploy incident-bot with feature flag incident_bot.runbook_enrichment=true in staging. 2) Trigger /runbook <service> in a test channel; ensure link and compact instructions render and link to Console. 3) Run /slo-summary <service> and validate SLO summary and suggested diagnostics. 4) Validate metrics (latency histogram and cache hit_rate) in telemetry. 5) Monitor e2e test that exercises Slack rendering.
notes: Opted for a small in-memory TTL cache with feature-flagged rollout to keep runtime risk minimal. If resolver external API is slow, fallback to storing canonical links in a lightweight runbook index in redis. Follow-up work: persist resolver index and add RBAC controls for runbook editing.
squash_details: Squashed 5 commits into one with cleanup of experimental logging and added metric assertions in tests.
impact_summary: Low-risk add-on: introduces new read-only resolver callouts and helper commands. Feature is off by default; no data plane changes. Adds small memory cache and metrics emission.
